title: LD's ServerInfo
description: A lightweight client-side Fabric mod that displays detailed information about the server you're connected to.
body:
## Features
**Info tab**
Server IP and real IP (resolved from socket)
Server version, brand, and software guess (Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Velocity, etc.)
Ping, online players, protocol version
World name, difficulty, in-game time
Estimated TPS (calculated client-side)
Detected anticheats (shown after plugin scan)
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
**Plugins tab**
Scans for server plugins using tab-complete packets
Detects plugins from namespaced commands in the command tree
Highlights known anticheats in red
Copy plugin list to clipboard
Rescan at any time
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
**Usage**
Press I (configurable in Controls settings) to open the Server Info panel while in-game.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________
